user.title: Digi România
user.description: Choose login (username, password and interactive 2FA) or an authenticated session cookie.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect Digi account
reconfigure.description: Renew this existing account session without deleting its sensors. Choose login to enter your password and the DIGI 2FA code, or cookie to import a fresh browser session.

reauth_confirm.title: Digi session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again to renew the session for this account. If DIGI requires 2FA, you will be asked for the code.

login.title: Sign in to Digi
login.description: Enter the credentials of this Digi account. Reconnecting an existing account cannot change its username.

cookie.title: Digi session cookie
cookie.description: Paste the Cookie request header from an authenticated DIGI browser session. The session will be verified before saving.

2fa_method.title: Digi two-factor authentication
2fa_method.description: Choose a method to request a verification code from DIGI.

2fa_code.title: Enter the Digi verification code
2fa_code.description: Enter the code sent by DIGI. If it is incorrect, you can try again without deleting the account.

address_select.title: Select Digi address
address_select.description: Choose the service address for this account.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to DIGI. Try again.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials, expired session or invalid verification code. Try again.
error.account_mismatch: Use the same username as this existing entry. Add a separate integration entry for a different account.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Account reconnected successfully. Existing sensors have been preserved.
abort.reauth_unsuccessful: The existing Digi entry was not found. Open the account integration and try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not verify the DIGI session. No changes were saved.
abort.invalid_auth: The session is not authenticated. No changes were saved. Please reconnect again.
abort.address_unavailable: DIGI no longer lists the saved service address. No changes were saved; check the addresses in your DIGI account.
